title: Lead Intake Webhook Contract (FEAT-LIW Chunk A)
description: Generic tenant-landing webhook. Each tenant's landing page/form POSTs a free-form payload; Invekto maps tenant fields to canonical fields via tenant_landing_settings.landing_field_map, normalizes phone to E.164, checks consent, then UPSERTs a lead and (for fresh leads) enqueues the welcome flow.

endpoint.auth: X-Invekto-Api-Key header (per-tenant pre-shared key, 24h grace rotation)

source_slug.description: Lowercase slug describing the source surface (e.g. 'ireland-roadshow-lp'). Stored on lead.source_slug; previous value overwritten on re-submission.

required.X-Invekto-Api-Key: Per-tenant API key; rotatable with 24h grace on old key

fields.description: Free-form source fields. Keys are the tenant's own field names; values are resolved to canonical via landing_field_map.

submitted_at.description: Tenant-side submission timestamp (optional; server NOW() used if missing)

canonical_fields.description: landing_field_map resolves source keys -> these canonical field names.
canonical_fields.phone_country_hint: Optional map entry 'phone.country_hint' (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) gives libphonenumber a parse hint when the source value is in national format.

response_field_semantics.lead_id: Invekto-side lead row id (stable across subsequent submissions under merge-by-phone).
response_field_semantics.duplicate: true when an existing lead row matched within the tenant's dup window (merge applied, no welcome re-enqueue). false when fresh or outside window (re-engagement path).
response_field_semantics.welcome_flow_enqueued: true only when Hangfire accepted the welcome-flow job (duplicate=false AND a welcome slug resolved AND enqueue succeeded). Reflects scheduling, NOT message delivery — the worker dispatches asynchronously on the `automation` queue with its own retries. Chunk A wires the enqueue path; the worker-side dispatch implementation lands in Chunk B.

400_payload_empty.message: Istek govdesi bos veya eksik; fields alani zorunlu

500_field_map_malformed.message: Tenant alan eslemesi bozuk, yetkili ile iletisime gecin

response_warnings.description: Non-fatal side-effect failures surfaced on a 201 response in the `warnings` array. Primary outcome (lead creation/merge) still succeeded; the caller can log/monitor these codes for ops visibility without polling server logs.

codes.INV-JOB-001: Hangfire storage (or enqueue) rejected the welcome-flow job. Lead was created; the welcome message will not fire until the tenant retries or Hangfire storage recovers.
codes.INV-JOB-002: DI/configuration error prevented the welcome-flow job handler from resolving. Lead was created; infra fix required to resume welcome automation.

rate_limit.retry_after_header: seconds until oldest request ages out (clamped to [1, 60])
rate_limit.v2_note: Redis-backed distributed counter for multi-instance scale-out

welcome_flow_trigger.condition: duplicate=false AND (lead is freshly created OR exited dup window)
welcome_flow_trigger.slug_fallback: tenant_landing_settings.welcome_flow_slug -> 'welcome_default' (Backend always emits a non-empty slug on enqueue; 'welcome_default' is a platform contract that Automation must resolve or raise INV-AT-068/069 worker-side).
welcome_flow_trigger.enqueue_failure_behavior: lead is still created; `welcome_flow_enqueued` returns false AND the response `warnings` array carries the Hangfire infra code (INV-JOB-001 storage, INV-JOB-002 handler-unresolved) so the caller has an explicit signal without reading server logs.
welcome_flow_trigger.worker_side_defensive: TriggerWelcomeFlowJob guards against an empty slug (defensive; Backend never sends one) and emits INV-AT-068 if reached. Chunk B adds the real dispatch path: slug → AutomationRepository.GetFlowByNameAndTenantAsync (chatbot_flows.flow_name treated as slug, no migration); a missing/inactive row emits INV-AT-069 and exits without retry.

wa_direct_internal_endpoint.purpose: Service-to-service entry point used by Automation when an inbound WhatsApp message arrives from a phone Backend doesn't yet know about. Caller is the Automation service (the AutomationOrchestrator wa-direct hook); end users never reach this endpoint. Implied consent under GDPR Recital 32 (user-initiated contact = clear affirmative action), so no consent field is required — distinct from the public landing endpoint.

endpoint.auth: X-Internal-Service-Token header; constant-time compare against InternalServices:SharedSecret config value (mirrors Zoho internal-auth pattern).

required.X-Internal-Service-Token: Shared cluster secret; rotate on both Backend and Automation appsettings + redeploy.

tenant_id.description: Resolved by Automation from the inbound TenantContext.

phone.description: Sender phone in any format; Backend normalizes via libphonenumber-csharp.

referer.description: WA click-to-chat referrer (e.g. ctwa_clid for Meta CTW ads). Stored in intake_metadata.referer when present; absent fields are silently omitted (no synthetic placeholder).

received_at.description: Inbound message timestamp (server NOW() used when null).

response_field_semantics.lead_id: Backend-side lead row id. Stable across subsequent inbounds via UNIQUE(tenant_id, phone).
response_field_semantics.is_new: true on a brand-new INSERT or out-of-window re-engagement (UPSERT happened); false on an in-window short-circuit (no UPSERT, no metadata churn, no welcome). Use this to tell whether welcome activity is expected.
response_field_semantics.welcome_flow_enqueued: true only when is_new=true AND a welcome slug resolved AND Hangfire accepted the job. Reflects scheduling, not delivery — same semantic as the landing endpoint.

400_payload_empty.message: Istek govdesi bos veya eksik; tenant_id zorunlu

401_token_missing.message: Servisler arasi yetki gecersiz veya yapilandirilmamis

403_token_mismatch.message: Servisler arasi yetki gecersiz veya yapilandirilmamis

wa_direct_internal_endpoint.duplicate_window: Reuses tenant_landing_settings.intake_dup_window_days (default 30 days, tenant override). One configuration knob covers both landing and wa-direct so attribution dashboards stay coherent.
wa_direct_internal_endpoint.channel_attribution: On a fresh INSERT or out-of-window re-engagement, `source` is set to 'whatsapp' and `source_slug` to 'wa-direct'. Cross-channel dup (e.g. landing form 5 days ago, then WA today) overwrites source_slug to the latest channel; full per-event history (channel, slug, timestamp) is preserved in intake_metadata.submission_<iso> snapshots so first-touch attribution can be reconstructed by iterating the JSONB. Welcome flow is suppressed within the dup window (no double-onboarding).
wa_direct_internal_endpoint.rate_limit: None applied (internal trusted caller). Automation can backoff on its own if Backend signals 5xx.

intake_metadata_shape.last_submission_at: ISO timestamp of most recent submission (this call when is_new=true).

dashboard_endpoints.purpose: Tenant-scoped Dashboard UI CRUD for landing settings (API key lifecycle, field map editor, dry-run preview, audit history). All endpoints are JWT-auth'd via Backend's JwtAuthMiddleware; tenant_id is extracted EXCLUSIVELY from the JWT claim — NO caller-supplied tenant_id parameter (IDOR prevention).
dashboard_endpoints.concurrency_model: Optimistic concurrency via tenant_landing_settings.updated_at used as opaque row_version. GET returns updated_at. Mutations (rotate/revoke/fieldmap.save) pass the observed updated_at via If-Match header or body.expected_row_version; UPDATE ... WHERE updated_at = @expected RETURNING updated_at; 0 rows -> 409 INV-BE-113. First-time rotate on a tenant with no row auto-creates the row (no If-Match required).
dashboard_endpoints.audit_trail: Every mutation emits an INSERT into liw_audit_log inside the SAME transaction as the settings UPDATE. Action vocabulary: 'apikey.rotate' | 'apikey.revoke' | 'fieldmap.save' | 'welcome_slug.change' (last reserved for future).

conditional.If-Match: Required on apikey.rotate (when row exists), apikey.revoke, fieldmap.save. Value is the updated_at ISO string from the last GET.

response_shape.masked_active_key: string | null (format: 'liw_live_****abcd' or null when not initialized / revoked)

rotate_apikey.if_match: Required when row already exists; omitted on first-time auto-create.

response_shape.active_plaintext: string (shown exactly once; full 64-char key with liw_live_ prefix)

revoke_apikey.response: 204 No Content (on success row.landing_api_key = NULL + row.landing_api_key_old = NULL)

request_shape.expected_row_version: ISO datetime (falls back to If-Match header when absent)

validation_rules: phone canonical must be mapped by at least one row (INV-BE-114)
consent canonical must be mapped by at least one row (INV-BE-114)
canonical value must be in allowlist: name|phone|email|consent|utm_source|utm_medium|utm_campaign|utm_content|utm_term|referer|metadata (INV-BE-115)
canonical target must be unique EXCEPT 'metadata' which allows multiple sources (INV-BE-114)

errors.400: INV-BE-114 | INV-BE-115 (errors[] array lists every failing row)

request_shape.source_slug: string (defaults to 'dryrun' when empty — slug format rules from landing endpoint apply)
request_shape.payload: object (the free-form fields payload that the tenant's landing page WOULD post)
request_shape.field_map_override: object | null (when non-null, validator is skipped AND this map is used instead of the saved field_map — lets the UI preview UNSAVED drafts without requiring a save; when null, the current saved field_map is used)

response_shape.warnings: string[] (human-readable explanations — missing required canonical, phone parse failure, consent missing, etc.)
response_shape.would_upsert: boolean (true when all required canonicals resolved AND phone normalized AND consent=true)
response_shape.would_trigger_welcome: boolean (true when would_upsert AND tenant is not in a duplicate-window scenario — dry-run does NOT query leads so this is a conservative estimate based on payload shape only)
response_shape.phone_e164: string | null (normalized phone when parse succeeded)

dry_run.security: JWT-auth'd + tenant-scoped; field_map_override affects only the caller's own response (no cross-tenant leak). Dry-run SKIPS strict FieldMapValidator so tenants can diagnose 'what would the resolver do with a bad map?' — errors surface in warnings[], not as 400.
dry_run.side_effects: None — no DB write, no flow enqueue, no audit entry.

entries[].user_display: string (User#{user_id} or 'Sistem' when user_id is null)
